beats: Opening: A lifter adds 100lb to his total in one year by cutting volume in half — the program did less, on purpose.
Evidence: Two identical trainees over 12 weeks — the one resting between hard sets gains more than the one chasing sweat.
Mechanism: Progressive overload explained as a system: add reps, then load, then sets — never all three at once.
Payoff: The 6AM rule — why the appointment with yourself beats motivation every single day.
